mapper.select: select crc32(t.table_name) as id, case when t.table_name in ('order_payment', 'order_refund', 'prepay_order', 'order_product') then 'order' when t.table_name like 'student%' then 'student' when t.table_name in ('sys_class', 'sys_class_schedule', 'sys_class_duty', 'sys_campus', 'sys_course', 'sys_course_detail') then 'teaching' when t.table_name like 'homework%' then 'homework' when t.table_name like 'exam%' or t.table_name like 'student_exam%' then 'exam' when t.table_name like 'ai_%' or t.table_name like 'prompt_template%' then 'ai' else 'other' end as business_domain, case when t.table_name in ('order_payment', 'order_refund', 'prepay_order', 'order_product') then '订单' when t.table_name like 'student%' then '学生' when t.table_name in ('sys_class', 'sys_class_schedule', 'sys_class_duty', 'sys_campus', 'sys_course', 'sys_course_detail') then '教学' when t.table_name like 'homework%' then '作业' when t.table_name like 'exam%' or t.table_name like 'student_exam%' then '考试' when t.table_name like 'ai_%' or t.table_name like 'prompt_template%' then 'AI' else '其他' end as business_domain_name, t.table_name, t.table_comment, 'ACTIVE' as status, 100 as sort_num, null as created_at, null as updated_at from information_schema.tables t where t.table_schema = database() and t.table_type = 'BASE TABLE' order by business_domain asc, t.table_name asc

select crc32(concat(t.table_name, '.', c.column_name)) as id, crc32(t.table_name) as table_id, case when t.table_name in ('order_payment', 'order_refund', 'prepay_order', 'order_product') then 'order' when t.table_name like 'student%' then 'student' when t.table_name in ('sys_class', 'sys_class_schedule', 'sys_class_duty', 'sys_campus', 'sys_course', 'sys_course_detail') then 'teaching' when t.table_name like 'homework%' then 'homework' when t.table_name like 'exam%' or t.table_name like 'student_exam%' then 'exam' when t.table_name like 'ai_%' or t.table_name like 'prompt_template%' then 'ai' else 'other' end as business_domain, case when t.table_name in ('order_payment', 'order_refund', 'prepay_order', 'order_product') then '订单' when t.table_name like 'student%' then '学生' when t.table_name in ('sys_class', 'sys_class_schedule', 'sys_class_duty', 'sys_campus', 'sys_course', 'sys_course_detail') then '教学' when t.table_name like 'homework%' then '作业' when t.table_name like 'exam%' or t.table_name like 'student_exam%' then '考试' when t.table_name like 'ai_%' or t.table_name like 'prompt_template%' then 'AI' else '其他' end as business_domain_name, t.table_name, t.table_comment, c.column_name, c.column_comment, 'ACTIVE' as status, c.ordinal_position as sort_num, null as created_at, null as updated_at from information_schema.tables t inner join information_schema.columns c on c.table_schema = database() and c.table_name = t.table_name where t.table_schema = database() and t.table_type = 'BASE TABLE' order by business_domain asc, t.table_name asc, c.ordinal_position asc
